name: mscse-4plus1-senior-no-admission-term
description: A 4+1 senior (bachelor's in Spring 2027, the current semester) who has not said when they were admitted to the Integrated B.S. + M.S. program. Since 2026-10-07 (DGS, policy review round 3, P3-fourplusone-1: a 4+1's graduate course the bachelor's did not use counts toward the MSCSE from any undergraduate term; §3.5's window limits only the courses shared with the bachelor's) CSE 60641, taken in Fall 2026 as an undergraduate and not shared with the bachelor's, counts — provisionally, because the transcript does not show it moved from UG to GR, so the senior is told to have it moved before conferral; and the record gets the three-degree warning. (From 2026-10-04 until then it read "not counted yet" until the admission term was entered.)
expectWarnings: Before your bachelor’s degree is conferred (Spring 2027): the graduate courses you are counting beyond the shared pair must be moved from undergraduate (UG) to graduate (GR) registration
CSE 60641 is a graduate course you took before your bachelor’s degree was awarded. No course counts toward three degrees
expectNoWarnings: If you were admitted to the Integrated B.S. + M.S. program by the semester you took

CSE 60641: would count toward regular courses (3 cr) once approved
counts only if it was moved from undergraduate (UG) to graduate (GR) registration
